mapper.insert: INSERT INTO async_task (id,task_no,task_key,owner_module,task_type,biz_type,biz_id, status,execute_at,expected_version,payload_json,max_retry_count,retry_policy,created_at,updated_at) VALUES (#{id},#{id},#{taskKey},#{ownerModule},#{taskType},#{bizType},#{bizId}, 'READY',UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),#{expectedVersion},CAST(#{payloadJson} AS JSON), #{maxRetryCount},#{retryPolicy},UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM async_task WHERE (status IN ('READY','RETRY_WAIT') AND execute_at <= NOW(3)) OR (status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_until < NOW(3)) ORDER BY priority DESC, execute_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(attempt_no),0) FROM async_task_attempt WHERE task_id=#{taskId}
mapper.update: UPDATE async_task_attempt SET result='RETRY', error_code='LEASE_EXPIRED', finished_at=NOW(3), duration_ms=GREATEST(0,TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND,started_at,NOW(3)) DIV 1000) WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND finished_at IS NULL

UPDATE async_task SET lease_until=TIMESTAMPADD(MICROSECOND,#{micros},NOW(3)), updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{taskId} AND status='RUNNING' AND lease_owner=#{owner} AND version=#{version} AND lease_until>=NOW(3)

UPDATE async_task SET status=#{state},retry_count=#{retryCount},last_result_code=#{resultCode}, last_error_code=#{errorCode},last_error_message=NULL,lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL,updated_at=NOW(3), execute_at=IF(#{state}='RETRY_WAIT',TIMESTAMPADD(MICROSECOND,#{delayMicros},NOW(3)),execute_at), finished_at=IF(#{state}='RETRY_WAIT',NULL,NOW(3)) WHERE id=#{taskId} AND status='RUNNING' AND lease_owner=#{owner} AND version=#{version} AND lease_until>=NOW(3)

UPDATE async_task_attempt SET result=#{attemptResult},error_code=#{errorCode},finished_at=NOW(3), duration_ms=GREATEST(0,TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND,started_at,NOW(3)) DIV 1000) WHERE id=#{attemptId} AND task_id=#{taskId} AND attempt_no=#{attemptNo} AND instance_id=#{instanceId} AND finished_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM async_task WHERE id=#{taskId} FOR UPDATE
